titles.title: Reducing Obesity in Youth Act of 2025
Reducing Obesity in Youth Act of 2025
To amend the Public Health Service Act to promote healthy eating and physical activity among children.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.

bill.summary:
Reducing Obesity in Youth Act of 2025
This bill requires the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, in coordination with the Administration for Children and Families, to award grants to nonprofits, institutions of higher education, or consortia of these entities to promote healthy eating and physical activity and address food insecurity among children from birth through age five in early care and education settings.
